name: Bioregenerative Life Support & Space Agriculture
summary: Using plants, algae and microbes to recycle air, water and waste and grow food for long missions and future habitats on the Moon and Mars.

Microbial waste processing and water recycling
Food systems and nutrition for long-duration missions
Space synthetic biology and biological in-situ resource utilisation (biomining)
Regolith as a growth medium: lunar and Martian soils
Microbial monitoring and contamination control in habitats
Stability and control of small closed ecosystems
